chunks: Yet they say: 'When will this promise come to pass? (Tell Us) if you speak the truth.'
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers ask regarding the timing of the resurrection?
ai.summary: In Surah An-Naml, this verse captures the impatient skepticism of the disbelievers who demand an immediate manifestation of the resurrection to validate the prophets' claims. Shia exegesis highlights this as a test of faith, where the 'truthfulness' condition reflects their internal doubt rather than a need for proof, illustrating the human tendency to seek tangible signs before accepting divine promise.
